mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_current_status (vehicle_id, status, battery, position_x, position_y, heading, speed, fork_height, has_cargo, cargo_id, footprint_length, footprint_width, message_at, received_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{status}, #{battery}, #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{heading}, #{speed}, #{forkHeight}, #{hasCargo}, #{cargoId}, #{footprintLength}, #{footprintWidth}, #{messageAt}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), battery = VALUES(battery), position_x = VALUES(position_x), position_y = VALUES(position_y), heading = VALUES(heading), speed = VALUES(speed), fork_height = VALUES(fork_height), has_cargo = VALUES(has_cargo), cargo_id = VALUES(cargo_id), footprint_length = VALUES(footprint_length), footprint_width = VALUES(footprint_width), message_at = VALUES(message_at), received_at = VALUES(received_at)

INSERT INTO vehicle_current_status (vehicle_id, status, position_x, position_y, heading, message_at, received_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, 'UNKNOWN', #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{heading}, #{messageAt}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE position_x = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR #{messageAt} > message_at THEN #{positionX} ELSE position_x END, position_y = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR #{messageAt} > message_at THEN #{positionY} ELSE position_y END, heading = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR #{messageAt} > message_at THEN #{heading} ELSE heading END, received_at = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR #{messageAt} > message_at THEN #{receivedAt} ELSE received_at END, message_at = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR #{messageAt} > message_at THEN #{messageAt} ELSE message_at END

INSERT INTO vehicle_current_status (vehicle_id, status, fork_state, fork_error_code, received_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, 'UNKNOWN', #{forkState}, #{forkErrorCode}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fork_state = VALUES(fork_state), fork_error_code = VALUES(fork_error_code), received_at = VALUES(received_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(s.status, 'UNKNOWN') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN vehicle_current_status s ON v.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id WHERE v.active = true GROUP BY COALESCE(s.status, 'UNKNOWN')
